mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals labor market deterioration, prompting central bank intervention that generates positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE increases by >0.3pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in housing starts (HOUST) indicates demand-supply rebalancing toward consumption-driven growth, yielding positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint INDPRO decline and HOUST rise fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction effect is statistically insignificant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0%) with tight monetary policy (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%), aggressive rate hikes compress equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
regime_hint: high inflation and tight monetary policy
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods meeting the regime condition.

mechanism_narrative: A two-month decline in industrial production below 100.0 (index base 2017=100) signals manufacturing contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 100.0 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Two consecutive months of housing starts below 1600.0 thousand units indicate residential sector weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST falls below 1600.0 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained industrial production growth above 102.0 (index base 2017=100) over three months reflects manufacturing expansion, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 102.0 for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A three-month federal funds rate increase above 5.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening, raising equity discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises above 5.0% over three months.
